newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin 13-wk T-bill avg yield at 18.25pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin 13-wk T-bill avg yield at 18.25pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak Finance Ministry auction of 13-week treasury bills on Wednesday was 18.248 percent, the central bank (NBS) said.
In the last successful auction of T-bills with similar maturity on April 9 the average yield was 14.84 perecent.
In the last Finance Ministry T-bill auction, a tranche of five-week paper on July 9, average yield was 16.048 percent.
The ministry accepted all 955 million crowns worth of bids. The minimum accepted yield was 16.00 percent, with the maximum yield hitting 19.60 percent.
The Finance Ministry on Wednesday also issued a 5.016 billion crown tranche of seven-day T-bills to NBS portfolio and a 1.300 billion-worth, eight-day T-bills to undisclosed market participant.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer at state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.790 billion crowns as of July 8, 1997, from 7.177 billion crowns in the January-May period of 1997.
